question.problem:
Consider the Poisson distribution $\text{Po}(12).$ Rounding to $4$ decimal digits, fill in the missing value in the corresponding table for the cumulative distribution function below.

| $\,x\,$ | $5$ | $6$ | $7$ | $8$ | $9$ | $10$ | $11$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $P(X\le x)$ | $\,0.0203\,$ | $\,0.0458\,$ | $\,0.0895\,$ | {{field-1}} | $\,0.2424\,$ | $\,0.3472\,$ | $\,0.4616\,$ |
question.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

The probability mass function for the Poisson distribution $\text{Po}(\lambda )$ is given by

$$
f(x)=\frac{{\lambda }^{x}{e}^{-\lambda }}{x!},\,x=0,1,2,3,…\,.
$$

In our case, $\lambda =12.$ 

Therefore, we compute the missing element of the table as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}F(8) & =P(X\le 8) \\  & =P(X\le 7)+P(X=8) \\  & =F(7)+P(X=8) \\  & =0.0895+\frac{{12}^{8}\cdot {e}^{-12}}{8!} \\  & ≈0.1550\end{aligned}
$$
